about.title: A little more about me
paragraphs: I have been interested in computing for several years, with a particular fascination for everything that lets me understand what happens behind the screen. This curiosity naturally led me to software development, but also to system administration. I enjoy designing an application as much as preparing the infrastructure that runs it.

Over time, I have built my own projects, experimented with different technologies and learned to manage servers, web services and production environments. This approach gives me a global vision of a project, from the initial idea to its deployment and maintenance.

My curiosity doesn’t stop at software. I also like exploring electronics and embedded systems through personal projects. Designing a weather station, building an alarm or automating a piece of equipment are all opportunities to connect the physical world and the digital world.

I also place great importance on activities that require rigor, patience and long-term progress. Climbing and calisthenics taught me the importance of perseverance, while gardening offers a different, calmer balance that helps me step back.

Every experience shapes the way I work. I like to analyze problems, understand their causes and build lasting solutions. More than just a profession, technology is for me a field of constant learning where there is always something to discover and improve.
